name: synapsidian
description: Local marketplace for the synapsidian plugins (installed in place from this repo).

plugins.name: synapsidian
plugins.description: Second brain in an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: synapsidian-work
plugins.description: Work add-on for synapsidian: 1:1s, stand-up, retros, a win log, pull requests, Jira, email and Slack asks.

plugins.name: synapsidian-projects
plugins.description: Projects add-on for synapsidian: a hub with a kanban board per project, and its notes filed under the project's folder.

plugins.name: synapsidian-dock
plugins.description: Dock add-on for synapsidian: the brief in a band above the prompt and a /synapsidian pane whose keys change a task without a Claude turn (a Claude Code mod).
